question: Who won the Men’s Single title at French Open 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rafael Nadal is a professional Lawn Tennis player from Spain.
 
• Spaniard Rafael Nadal on 5 June 2022 won the 14th singles title of the French open beating Casper Ruud of Norway 6-3, 6-3, 6-0 in the final. 
 
• With this victory, 36-year-old Nadal has become the oldest champion of the French Open.
 
• It is his 22nd Grand Slam title.
 
• In women's singles, World Number One Iga Swiatek of Poland won the 2022 title by beating Coco Gauf in Paris on 4 June 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The French Open, also known as Roland-Garros, is a major tennis tournament.
 
• It is held over two weeks at the Stade Roland Garros in Paris, France, beginning in late May each year.
 
• The tournament and venue are named after the French aviator Roland Garros. 
 
• ​The French Open:
 
 
• Founded: 1891
 
• Location: Paris, France
 
• Surface: Clay – outdoors (1908–present); Sand – outdoors (1891–1907)
 
 
 
• Japan's Ena Shibahara and Wesley Koolhof of the Netherlands won the French Open mixed doubles title on 2 June 2022.
